heart.title: BodyParts3D anatomical heart
heart.creator: The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS)
heart.credit: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International
heart.changes: Original mesh bytes unchanged; EKG Lab adds runtime illustrative materials, schematic activation and stylized beating.
heart.limitations: Reference anatomy, not patient-specific. Combined ventricular wall; separately named ventricular cavities are spaces, not myocardium. Simplified vessel segments, omitted valves and veins. No independent clinical anatomy or physiological validation.

chest.title: Co-registered chest bones and skin
chest.creator: The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS)
chest.credit: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International
chest.changes: Selected chest structures from BodyParts3D 4.0; skin clipped to chest height with open cut edges; preserved original triangles; recomputed normals and illustrative materials. Identical transform to heart.glb.
chest.limitations: Reference anatomy with simplified geometry. Skin slab includes upper arms. Educational electrode anchors are approximate surface positions, not clinical placement measurements.
